content: Standardpharm Co., Ltd. is a U.S.-based specialty chemical enterprise headquartered at 363 East 42nd Street, New York, NY 10017. Established with a strong commitment to scientific integrity, regulatory compliance, and customer-centric innovation, the company specializes in the development, synthesis, and distribution of high-purity pharmaceutical intermediates, custom fine chemicals, and research-grade active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Though its operational footprint spans North America, Europe, and Asia, Standardpharm distinguishes itself through rigorous quality control systems aligned with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), ISO 9001 standards, and strict adherence to FDA, EMA, and ICH guidelines. The company serves a global clientele—including biotech start-ups, generic drug manufacturers, academic institutions, and contract research organizations—providing tailored synthesis services, route scouting, process optimization, and analytical support (HPLC, NMR, LC-MS, XRD). Its state-of-the-art R&D facility in New York supports rapid prototyping and scalable batch production from milligram to multi-kilogram quantities. Importantly, Standardpharm maintains full transparency in regulatory documentation, offering comprehensive regulatory dossiers (e.g., CTD/IMPD modules), full traceability of starting materials, and robust stability and impurity profiling. While the company operates ethically and sustainably—with green chemistry principles embedded in process design—it does not engage in the wholesale distribution of controlled substances or unapproved drug products. Standardpharm Co., Ltd. continues to expand its portfolio of novel heterocyclic compounds, chiral building blocks, and PROTAC-linkers—reflecting its strategic focus on enabling next-generation therapeutics.
